title: 大阪杯の後に・整わない呼吸

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket runs as fast as she can and manages to barely win against Narita Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But it's not their heated rivalry that has left an impression on the spectators—all the fans can talk about is Taishin's explosive sprinting.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket becomes motivated to work even harder, so as not to lose to Narita Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ever enthusiastic, she sets her sights on the Takarazuka Kinen, the race to conclude the first half of the Twinkle Series.
